_comment_s104: S104 (2026-08-12) added ignore glob '*/rebuild/dist/*'. RATIONALE, stated openly because narrowing MCV scope silently is exactly what this mechanism exists to prevent: rebuild/dist is esbuild+asset BUILD OUTPUT, is listed in rebuild/.gitignore, and is regenerated byte-identically by `npm run build` from sources that ARE diff-bound (src/**, tools/**). Asserting on it would bind claims to artefacts rather than to authored code. This exactly mirrors the pre-existing '*/public/dist/*' entry for the frozen old build. The SOURCES of those artefacts (tools/build-atlas.py, tools/build-player.py, src/art/*) remain diff-bound and carry content assertions in S104 P2.
_comment: S102 (2026-07-17) PROJECT-LOCAL MCV watch config (S258 mechanism) for Legacy of the Realm. Scopes diff-binding to THIS project's agent-authored surfaces; the global config's WS1 toolkit roots (~/.claude/scripts|hooks|skills, parent-workspace plans/boot-snapshot) belong to parent-workspace sessions and were tripping cross-session false-positive UNBOUND fails here (8 on 2026-07-17, all S176 DB-durability work from another seat). Roots below = the FROZEN old build (must not change post pre-rebuild-final tag — any drift needs a binding assertion) + the future rebuild/ surface + root plan/backlog docs. archive/ is deliberately NOT a diff-bound root: it is verified by its own mechanical checker (archive/tools/coverage.mjs) + per-priority verification[] bindings on key files.
_comment_s105: S105 (2026-08-12) added ignore glob '*/rebuild/realm/realm.db'. RATIONALE, stated openly because narrowing MCV scope silently is exactly what this mechanism exists to prevent: realm.db is a DERIVED INDEX, listed in rebuild/.gitignore, deleted and rebuilt from scratch by `npm run realm:build` out of realm/*.json -- and every one of those seven JSON sources IS diff-bound and carries content assertions in S105 P1/P2. Asserting on the .db would bind claims to an artefact rather than to authored data. This mirrors the existing '*/rebuild/dist/*' and '*/public/dist/*' entries exactly. The realm/*.json sources remain diff-bound.
